answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust atlas for navigating identity in decentralized networks by requiring agents to commit economic capital to validate transactions. This mechanism functions by linking influence to stake rather than IP addresses, effectively turning a meadow of anonymous nodes into a secure ecosystem. To harbor malicious intent, an attacker must acquire a majority of total network assets, imposing a prohibitive financial cost that renders Sybil attacks economically irrational and technically infeasible.
